title: Agent Brief / Delegation Reflex
desc: Reflex for handling [agent-brief] triggers and delegation misconfigurations.
steps: When you trigger [agent-brief] (Rising Pattern or DELEGATION_MISCONFIGURED): read harness-agent-brief-guard, ensure the brief has 3+ skill reads and 5 SPEC sections (Goal, Files, Approach, Constraints, Exit). Fix the brief instead of doing the work manually.
author: claude
